DRAFT MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  AUGUST 6, 2018

A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by CHAIR
SCHACHTER.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  CHAIR SCHACHTER led the assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.

3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Schachter, Yoo, Scott, Carman, Edler

  Commissioners Absent:  Medawar, Zigrang

  Staff Present:  Sr. Planner Naughton, Associate Planner Thom
  Administrative Assistant Corea

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER CARMAN to,

  APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF
  JUNE 4, 2018.

  There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered.

5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A. WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL RESOLUTIONS THAT ARE PRESENTED FOR THE
  CONSIDERATION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION ON TONIGHT’S AGENDA AND
  ALL SUCH RESOLUTIONS SHALL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6-A

  There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered.

7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  NONE

  1
Draft Planning Commission Minutes
August 6, 2018
 8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A. PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 03-18; APPLICANT: MR. PHILIP CHOI; LOCATION:
  3809 PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH; A request for a minor subdivision – subdividing
  one lot into two, residentially zoned RA-20 lots.

  CHAIR SCHACHTER stated that the Planning Commission received an e-mail comment
  from Christian Sorenson, who is also a client at his law firm, and stated that he will
  withdraw from participating on this item.

  Sr. Planner Naughton provided a PowerPoint presentation for this item summarizing the
  staff report. Sr. Planner Naughton stated that the most significant condition for this project
  is the intermediate turnaround which is required by the fire department for improved
  emergency access.

  Sr. Planner Naughton stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission open
  the public hearing, take public testimony, discuss the issues, close the public hearing, and
  adopt Resolution No. PA-03-18, approving Tentative Parcel Map No. 82074.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked about the driveway cut shown on the plans in parcel no.
  2. Sr. Planner Naughton stated that that is the intermediate turnaround required by the fire
  department.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that the e-mail received from Christian Sorenson raises
  concern that the land is fill and is moving. Sr. Planner Naughton stated that historically
  there is landfill in this portion of Palos Verdes Drive North to the South Coast Botanic
  Garden and when the applicants go to Building and Safety they will need to address those
  issues. COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked if it is known if there is waste vs. landfill at the
  site and stated that this will also need to be addressed before developing the site.

  Philip Choi, Applicant, stated that he and his wife would like to raise their family in Rolling
  Hills Estates.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked why they want to subdivide the property. Mr. Choi stated
  that the existing home, although nice, is not to their liking and they would like to build a
  home on the second half and later sell the existing home.

  Helena Lopez, 3745 Palos Verdes Drive North, stated that she hopes that between the 8
  neighbors, they will be able to come up with a street name. Ms. Lopez stated that she
  was under the impression that the turnaround was the parking for the neighbor at the end
  of the street, and lastly 3805 and 3809 are subject of constant land movement and is
  concerned if the applicant is not aware of this.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked if there is a condition that the turnaround not be used for
  parking. Sr. Planner Naughton stated that the fire department will require that the curb be
  painted red and that signs be installed, however, there have been problems with enforcing
  this.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT expressed his concern with waste being found on the land. Sr.
  Planner Naughton stated that DTSC would become involved if waste was discovered
  anywhere on the property and would be addressed during the permitting process.

  2
Draft Planning Commission Minutes
August 6, 2018
   Helena Lopez asked how are sign ordinances proposed to be enforced on a private street.
  Sr. Planner Naughton stated that that is one of the challenges with private developments
  and it is ultimately the city’s responsibility to enforce.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER EDLER to,

  CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING

  There being no objections, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered.

  COMMISSIONER YOO asked what the requirements are to allow a lot to be subdivided.
  Sr. Planner Naughton stated that as long as the development standards are met and the
  subdivision does not create any non-conforming situations, then they are allowed by law
  to subdivide the lot.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION PA-03-18 AS RECOMMENDED BY
  STAFF.

  Ayes:  YOO, CARMAN, SCOTT, EDLER
  Noes:
  Absent:  MEDAWAR, ZIGRANG
  Abstain:  SCHACHTER

  Sr. Planner Naughton stated that there is a 10-day appeal period for this item. The final
  parcel map will be prepared and sent to fire and then to City Council for approval.

  B. PLANNING APPLICATION NO. 08-18; APPLICANT: KENNETH HEILFRON; LOCATION:
  2301 CARRIAGE DRIVE; A request for a Neighborhood Compatibility Determination to
  demolish the existing one-story residence for a proposed one-story residence with a
  basement and an attached garage. A Variance is requested to encroach into the required
  front yard beyond the fowardmost building line. A second Variance is requested to
  decrease the front yard area by more than 10%. A Grading Application is required for a
  new retaining wall.

  Associate Planner Thom provided a PowerPoint presentation on this item summarizing
  the staff report.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission
  open the public hearing, take public testimony, discuss the issues, close the public
  hearing, and adopt Resolution No. PA-08-18 approving the project.

  Jeff Lyon, Architect, clarified the height of the proposed house, further explained that the
  design of the house will give the appearance that it is setback more than the existing
  house. The property owners have discussed this project with many of their neighbors who
  have all signed off on the project. There was an issue with the neighbor on the uphill side
  of the property, but that has been resolved.

  CHAIR SCHACHTER stated that a letter was sent in opposition of the project by a
  neighbor regarding the encroachment of the front yard. Mr. Lyon stated that the design
  will actually increase the front yard appearance.

  3
Draft Planning Commission Minutes
August 6, 2018
   COMMISSIONER SCOTT expressed his concern with the dominance of garages in the
  front façade found in the Larga Vista neighborhood. Mr. Lyon stated that he has attempted
  to soften the appearance by setting it back and the choice of garage doors.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCOTT, Mr. Lyon stated that the side
  gates can be pushed back further than what is shown on the plan.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN stated that the presentation shows pictures of homes with
  three-car garages which are parallel with the street giving more front area to absorb the
  impact of the garage doors. This property is more perpendicular and asked if it is possible
  to make the driveway narrowed down. Mr. Lyon stated that if it is possible, he will try to
  narrow it down.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN stated that she recommends that the gate not have a
  Mediterranean design and that there be landscaping added to the area around the
  driveway. Mr. Lyon stated that a landscape architect has already developed a schematic
  landscape plan for this project.

  COMMISSIONER EDLER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

  CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING

  There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER EDLER to,

  APPROVE RESOLUTION NO. 08-18 AS RECOMMENDED BY STAFF,
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING: 1) THE APPROVAL FOR THE GATE ON THE
  RIGHT SIDE BE MOVED BACK 5 FT. FROM THE FRONT WALL OF THE
  GARAGE AND ANY ISSUES THAT MAY ARISE IN DOING THIS WOULD BE AT
  STAFF’S DISCRETION TO REDUCE; 2) THAT THE GATE DESIGN BE
  CONSISTENT WITH THE RANCH STYLE AND SUBJECT TO STAFF’S FINAL
  APPROVAL ON MATERIAL AND APPEARANCE; 3) THAT THE OVERALL
  STYLE OF THE GARAGE DOORS DEEMPASIZE THE GARAGE DOOR
  ELEMENT AND BE SUBJECT TO STAFF’S FINAL APPROVAL; 4) THAT THE
  DRIVEWAY BE THE MINIMUM WIDTH THAT THE ENGINEER WILL APPROVE
  AND SUBJECT TO STAFF’S FINAL APPROVAL.

  Ayes:  SCHACHTER, YOO, CARMAN, SCOTT, EDLER
  Noes:
  Absent:  MEDAWAR, ZIGRANG
  Abstain:

9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER asked about the unmaintained home on the “no name
  street”. Sr. Planner Naughton stated that this will be brought up to code enforcement.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER inquired about the CalWater project being on schedule.
  Sr. Planner Naughton stated that there were a couple of incidents that caused the project
  to be shut down for 2 full days. There may be a 1-day delay in reopening the street. Sr.
  Naughton provided information on the closures for the next part of the project.

  4
Draft Planning Commission Minutes
August 6, 2018
 10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  Sr. Planner Naughton reminded the Planning Commission to respond with availability for
  the joint meeting with the City Council to discuss the General Plan Update. The dates that
  are being proposed are September 25th and October 9th.

11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, JUNE 12, 2018.

  B. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, JUNE 26, 2018.

  C. CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, JULY 10, 2018

  D. DRAFT MINUTES OF THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING JULY 16,
  2018

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE ITEMS 11-A THROUGH 11-D.

  There being no objection, CHAIR SCHACHTER so ordered.

12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR SCHACHTER adjourned the meeting. The next Planning Commission meeting is
  scheduled on Monday, September 10, 2018 at 7:00 p.m.
